United by our strong academic performance, passion for technology, and commitment to continuous learning, we constantly strive to challenge ourselves and turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions.

Our dedication to academic excellence and our desire to go beyond traditional learning inspired us to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge
summary:
FLAMEVERSE is an innovative AI-powered platform designed to explore and understand how flames and combustion behave in microgravity environments, particularly aboard spacecraft.

By utilizing NASA scientific experiment data, FLAMEVERSE transforms complex scientific information into interactive visualizations and accessible explanations. The platform allows users to explore flame behavior in space, analyze experimental results, understand combustion phenomena, and discover how microgravity changes the way fire behaves compared to Earth.

Our solution combines artificial intelligence, scientific data analysis, interactive 3D visualization, and educational tools to make advanced space research easier to understand and explore.

Our mission is to bridge the gap between complex NASA research and accessible scientific knowledge, helping students, researchers, and space enthusiasts better understand the science of combustion in space.
details:
FLAMEVERSE – Project Details

FLAMEVERSE is an innovative AI-powered educational and scientific platform designed to explore flame behavior and combustion in microgravity environments.

The Problem

Fire behaves very differently in space compared to Earth due to the absence of normal gravitational convection. Understanding these differences is essential for astronaut safety, spacecraft fire prevention, and future space missions. However, scientific data about combustion in microgravity can be difficult for students and the general public to understand and explore.

Our Solution

FLAMEVERSE transforms complex scientific research into an accessible and interactive experience. By combining artificial intelligence, NASA scientific datasets, data analysis, and interactive visualizations, our platform helps users understand how flames behave in microgravity.

Key Features

  • AI-powered assistant for answering questions about combustion in space.
  • Interactive visualizations explaining flame behavior in microgravity.
  • NASA scientific data exploration and analysis.
  • Educational explanations of combustion concepts.
  • Scientific insights that help users compare flame behavior on Earth and in space.

Impact

FLAMEVERSE aims to make space science more accessible, support STEM education, and raise awareness about the challenges of fire safety in spacecraft. It also demonstrates how artificial intelligence can help transform complex scientific information into meaningful knowledge.

Our Vision

We believe that understanding fire in space is an important step toward safer human space exploration. Through FLAMEVERSE, we aim to make scientific discovery more interactive, accessible, and inspiring for everyone.
